title: Authoritative Data Acquisition Manifest Registry
description: Cryptographic and provenance audit manifest for all primary datasets in the Breakwave ETF Accounting Suite.

sec_form_10q_shares_outstanding.title: SEC Form 10-Q Disclosed Shares Outstanding
sec_form_10q_shares_outstanding.source_entity: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) EDGAR / Amplify ETF Trust
sec_form_10q_shares_outstanding.description: Quarterly balance sheet disclosed common shares outstanding.
sec_form_10q_shares_outstanding.gap_documented: Lacks daily point-in-time resolution. Intervening share basket additions/redemptions are unobserved.
sec_form_10q_shares_outstanding.unfreeze_recommendation: DO NOT UNFREEZE DAILY SHARE ACCOUNTING (Requires daily transfer agent ledger).

daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.title: Daily Transfer Agent / NSCC CNS Share Capital Ledger
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.source_entity: U.S. Bancorp Fund Services, LLC / Foreside Fund Services, LLC
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.description: Daily transfer agent share registers and NSCC Continuous Net Settlement (CNS) basket logs.
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.institutional_owner: U.S. Bank Global Fund Services / Authorized Participants
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.access_requirement: Direct custodian institutional data feed agreement with fund sponsor.
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.cost_licensing: Restricted to authorized fund participants and registered institutional sponsors.
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.gap_documented: Daily share count changes and exact creation/redemption execution timing remain unobserved.
daily_transfer_agent_shares_ledger.unfreeze_recommendation: CANNOT UNFREEZE FUND-LEVEL TOTAL NAV TO PER-SHARE RECONSTRUCTION.

inferred_shares_from_flow_division.title: Synthetic Shares Inferred from USD Flow / Daily NAV
inferred_shares_from_flow_division.description: Dividing disclosed daily USD net flow by NAV to approximate shares.
inferred_shares_from_flow_division.rejection_reason: Violates financial accounting integrity: does not account for AP creation premiums/discounts, trade date vs settlement date (T+1/T+2) lags, or transaction fees.

bdry_official_nav_history.title: BDRY Official Published Net Asset Value (NAV) History
bdry_official_nav_history.source_entity: Amplify ETFs / Breakwave Advisors / U.S. Bank Global Fund Services
bdry_official_nav_history.description: Official published daily NAV per share, daily USD capital flow, and daily fund performance.
bdry_official_nav_history.gap_documented: Missing non-trading weekend snapshots (e.g. 2026-06-21 Sunday). Total net assets in USD requires daily share ledger.
bdry_official_nav_history.unfreeze_recommendation: SUFFICIENT FOR PER-SHARE BENCHMARK PERFORMANCE COMPARISON ONLY.

bwet_official_nav_history.title: BWET Official Published Net Asset Value (NAV) History
bwet_official_nav_history.source_entity: Amplify ETFs / Breakwave Advisors / U.S. Bank Global Fund Services
bwet_official_nav_history.description: Official published daily NAV per share, daily USD capital flow, and daily fund performance.
bwet_official_nav_history.gap_documented: Missing non-trading weekend snapshots. Total net assets in USD requires daily share ledger.
bwet_official_nav_history.unfreeze_recommendation: SUFFICIENT FOR PER-SHARE BENCHMARK PERFORMANCE COMPARISON ONLY.

daily_total_net_assets_dollars.title: Daily Total Net Assets in USD (AUM)
daily_total_net_assets_dollars.cadence: Quarterly in 10-Q (Daily unobserved in public CSVs)
daily_total_net_assets_dollars.description: Total fund net assets in USD.
daily_total_net_assets_dollars.gap_documented: Public daily CSVs disclose NAV per share and USD flow, but omit total dollar net assets on daily basis.
daily_total_net_assets_dollars.unfreeze_recommendation: DO NOT UNFREEZE TOTAL DOLLAR NAV WATERFALL WITHOUT DIRECT CUSTODIAN LEDGER.

sec_10q_balance_sheet_cash.title: SEC Form 10-Q Disclosed Cash & Collateral Balances
sec_10q_balance_sheet_cash.description: Quarterly audited cash, money market, broker margin, and accrued liability balances.
sec_10q_balance_sheet_cash.gap_documented: Does not provide daily cash fluctuations, overnight repo sweeps, or daily interest credit transactions.
sec_10q_balance_sheet_cash.unfreeze_recommendation: SUFFICIENT FOR QUARTERLY POINT-IN-TIME BALANCE SHEET FIXTURES ONLY.

daily_marex_fcm_margin_equity.title: Daily Segregated FCM Cash & Variation Margin Ledgers
daily_marex_fcm_margin_equity.description: Daily line-item broker variation margin transfers, intraday margin calls, and segregated cash balances.
daily_marex_fcm_margin_equity.institutional_owner: Marex Financial Ltd / Breakwave Advisors Trading Desk
daily_marex_fcm_margin_equity.access_requirement: FCM clearing account statements / FIX trade confirmation drop copies.
daily_marex_fcm_margin_equity.gap_documented: Daily cash transfers between custodian and FCM remain unobserved.

daily_usbank_custody_interest_expense_le.title: Daily Custody Bank Interest Credit & Expense Deduction Ledgers
daily_usbank_custody_interest_expense_le.description: Daily overnight cash repo interest vouchers and daily advisory/custody fee accrual debits.
daily_usbank_custody_interest_expense_le.institutional_owner: U.S. Bank Global Fund Services (Fund Custodian & Administrator)
daily_usbank_custody_interest_expense_le.gap_documented: Exact daily cash interest credits and exact daily operating expense bills are unobserved.
daily_usbank_custody_interest_expense_le.unfreeze_recommendation: CANNOT UNFREEZE CASH INTEREST / EXPENSE ACCRUAL WATERFALL.

fixed_rate_synthetic_cash_expense_estima.title: Synthetic Compounding at 4.85% APY and 3.50% TER Cap
fixed_rate_synthetic_cash_expense_estima.description: Applying fixed annual rates day by day.
fixed_rate_synthetic_cash_expense_estima.rejection_reason: Synthetic estimation violates accounting standards: ignores SOFR rate fluctuations, actual cash proportions, fee waivers, and non-linear billing schedules.

sgx_dry_bulk_ffa_curves.title: SGX Cleared Dry Bulk FFA Forward Settlement Curves
sgx_dry_bulk_ffa_curves.description: Historical exchange-cleared daily settlement prices for dry bulk freight forward agreements.
sgx_dry_bulk_ffa_curves.gap_documented: Covers dry bulk only. Does not contain wet tanker freight contracts.
sgx_dry_bulk_ffa_curves.unfreeze_recommendation: SUFFICIENT FOR DRY BULK (BDRY) DERIVATIVE VALUATION BENCHMARKING.

historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.title: CME / ICE Exchange Cleared Tanker FFA Historical Curves (TD3C & TD20)
historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.source_entity: CME Group / Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) / Baltic Exchange
historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.description: Daily cleared settlement prices for Baltic VLCC TD3C and Suezmax TD20 futures strips.
historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.institutional_owner: CME Group / ICE / Baltic Exchange Ltd
historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.access_requirement: Commercial market data subscription (CME DataMine / Baltic Exchange API).
historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.gap_documented: Historical tanker forward curve settlement marks are unobserved prior to recent snapshots.
historical_tanker_ffa_clearing_marks.unfreeze_recommendation: CANNOT UNFREEZE LONG-TERM HISTORICAL BWET FFA CURVE RECONSTRUCTION.

spot_baltic_index_proxy_substitution.title: Spot Baltic Index (BDTI/BCTI) Proxy Substitution for Tanker FFAs
spot_baltic_index_proxy_substitution.description: Using spot freight indices as a proxy for forward tanker contract marks.
spot_baltic_index_proxy_substitution.rejection_reason: Violates non-substitution governance: spot freight excludes forward curve contango/backwardation term premium, storage costs, and Samuelson volatility damping.

bdry_daily_holdings_archive.title: BDRY Daily Disclosed Constituent Holdings Archive
bdry_daily_holdings_archive.description: Point-in-time daily constituent contract lots, prices, market values, and collateral lines.
bdry_daily_holdings_archive.gap_documented: Discloses end-of-day snapshot lots only; does not disclose intraday trade transaction timestamps or execution prices.
bdry_daily_holdings_archive.unfreeze_recommendation: SUFFICIENT FOR OBSERVED RETAINED FUTURES VARIATION MARGIN ONLY.

bwet_daily_holdings_archive.title: BWET Daily Disclosed Constituent Holdings Archive
bwet_daily_holdings_archive.description: Point-in-time daily constituent contract lots, prices, market values, and collateral lines.
bwet_daily_holdings_archive.gap_documented: Discloses end-of-day snapshot lots only; does not disclose intraday trade transaction timestamps or execution prices.
bwet_daily_holdings_archive.unfreeze_recommendation: SUFFICIENT FOR OBSERVED RETAINED FUTURES VARIATION MARGIN ONLY.

intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.title: Intraday FCM Order Execution & Trade Confirmation Logs
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.source_entity: Marex Financial Ltd / Breakwave Advisors Execution Desk
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.description: Exact transaction fill prices, fill timestamps, broker commissions, and execution slippage during the 4-week quarterly roll window.
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.institutional_owner: Marex Financial Ltd / Fund Execution Desk
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.access_requirement: Broker FIX execution drop copies or institutional daily trade confirmation reports.
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.cost_licensing: Proprietary fund trading records; unavailable publicly.
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.gap_documented: Exact transaction costs and realized P&L on rolled contracts cannot be measured directly.
intraday_roll_execution_fill_logs.unfreeze_recommendation: CANNOT UNFREEZE DETERMINISTIC ROLL COST ATTRIBUTION.

synthetic_mid_settlement_roll_prices.title: Synthetic Roll Execution at Mid-Market Daily Settlement
synthetic_mid_settlement_roll_prices.description: Assuming prompt and next-quarter roll trades execute exactly at 4:00 PM EST exchange settlement.
synthetic_mid_settlement_roll_prices.rejection_reason: Synthetic assumption masks true execution spread, market impact, and intraday timing drag.
